nodes.description: address public owner of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in constructor.
address public newOwner pending ownership transfer target.
string public symbol of the token, set to 'STAN'.
string public name of the token, set to 'Stanley Token'.
uint8 public decimals, set to 5.
uint public total token supply, 100000000000000000.
mapping(address => uint) of token balances; mutated by transfer/transferFrom and constructor.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of allowances; mutated by approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall.
public pure safeAdd(uint a, uint b) returns uint c with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
public pure safeSub(uint a, uint b) returns uint c with require(b <= a) underflow guard.
public pure safeMul(uint a, uint b) returns uint c with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
public pure safeDiv(uint a, uint b) returns uint c with require(b > 0) zero-divisor guard.
Constructor of Owned assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function setting newOwner = _newOwner (two-step ownership transfer step 1).
Sets owner = newOwner after require(msg.sender == newOwner); emits OwnershipTransferred; resets newOwner.
Constructor minting entire _totalSupply to a fixed address and emitting Transfer.
constant returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
constant returns balances[tokenOwner].
public returns bool; safeSub from msg.sender, safeAdd to 'to', emits Transfer, returns true.
public returns bool; writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens, emits Approval, returns true.
public returns bool; safeSub balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], safeAdd balances[to], emits Transfer.
constant returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
public returns bool; sets allowance then performs external call spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data).
payable fallback function that always reverts, refusing ETH.
onlyOwner function performing external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
msg.sender used to initialize owner in Owned constructor.
msg.sender compared to owner in onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender used as the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender used as the spender key in allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender used as allowance owner and as argument to the external receiveApproval call.
Unsigned addition c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a) inside safeAdd.
Unsigned subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a) inside safeSub.
Unsigned multiplication c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b) inside safeMul.
Unsigned division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0) inside safeDiv.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled address after allowance state write.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token contract address.
Access-control check require(msg.sender == owner) in the onlyOwner modifier.
Access-control check require(msg.sender == newOwner) in acceptOwnership.

safeAdd performs the guarded unsigned addition operation.
safeSub performs the guarded unsigned subtraction operation.
safeMul performs the guarded unsigned multiplication operation.

transfer debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub.

acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
transferOwnership stores the pending owner into newOwner.
